fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo

let subject = "alphaBETA"
let invariant = CultureInfo.invariant_culture

write_line("upper: {subject.to_upper_invariant()}")
write_line("lower: {subject.to_lower_invariant()}")
write_line("title: {invariant.text_info.to_title_case(subject)}")
output:
upper:      ALPHABETA
lower:      alphabeta
title:      Alphabeta
